big_case.notes: Fired tenured professor's First Amendment retaliation claim against a public university, raising the Garcetti academic-freedom reservation and a Sullivan-malice gloss on Pickering. The doctrinal question is genuinely open and the race-and-intelligence research subject draws attention, but the vehicle was an unpublished Sixth Circuit affirmance on causation, the respondents waived, and the denial drew no noted dissent or statement. Low stakes as decided; any merits decision on this record would have been narrow.
